dialogs.content: Oh, my child... My child is locked up in there...
But my child is locked up in there. If I could just stage a rescue...
The door has been opened...
Eh, it must've been the two outland visitors from earlier... Ah, thank goodness!
Right. I know what to do. Hmph, that lying liar who lies shall receive well-deserved punishment!
Hmph, just keep playing that game. That sneaky swindler is going to taste utter defeat this time!
Oh-ho, a foreign guest!
I guess arriving at the right time is better than being early. I just set this stall up today, and here you are.
What fantastic luck, hehe!
You do have pretty good luck.
Oh, no, no, dear guest. I'm not talking about my luck, but yours!
Our luck?
Indeed! Not everyone gets the chance to take the most ancient trial on the Hued-Jade Heights — the Painted Stone Challenge!
This is a trial left behind by the legendary hero of the Masters of the Night-Wind, um... Vallejodaken, designed to train the memory of our tribespeople and their ability to perceive color.
Wait, was there ever such a hero from the Masters of the Night-Wind...?
Why, the tribe has a long and profound history. How could you outsiders hope to know all of it, eh?
But you're not from the Masters of the Night-Wind, are you?

...W—Well now! What does a legendary hero's trial have to do with which tribe I'm from? The six major tribes were established so long ago, surely it is high time the barriers between them went down... *ahem*.
Anyway, lucky travelers from afar — why don't you listen in on the rules of the Painted Stone Challenge? To be honest, the rewards I prepared are so generous it gives me conniptions!
R—Really?
#It still sounds fishy, but there's no harm in listening... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?
You'll hear it no matter what I say...
C'mon, a good adventurer should never pass up a chance for extra rewards!
Then allow me, the heir of the hero Vallekan, to explain the rules to you...
Wait, did that name just change, or...
Change? No, no, it was always the same name. *sigh* You foreigners just have trouble remembering the mighty names of our ancient heroes — but that's okay. Anyway, here's how the rules work...
When the challenge begins, the Iktomisaurus next to me will create differently-colored stones on the empty platform, which will disappear shortly...
What you must do is use the <color=#00E1FFFF>Hued Monetoo to grant color that corresponds</color> to the stones on each platform. As long as the colors match, you pass the stage.
So, this is actually a memory game. How about it? Pretty simple, right?
That doesn't sound very difficult...
Plus, there's two of us, so it's just remembering a couple of colors...
Yes, yes. Oh-ho, isn't today your lucky day? But it's also an unlucky day — for my wallet.
So then, if you wish to play, it'll cost you 500 Mora to take part.
What, you still want Mora for this?

Ah, but what you don't know, dear guest, is that the trials of our heroes have been passed down through the generations and have required much expenditure to maintain... Such tremendous efforts are beyond the ken of outsiders.
Besides, compared with the final reward, 500 Mora is a drop in the bucket. Ah, it's more like a barrier to entry, testing a challenger's sincerity in wanting to experience the trial...
Okay okay, well...
#Paimon's gonna fork up the fee, {NICKNAME}, but you gotta win!
Okay then, you two: Shall we get things started?
Well, let's see what you call "lucky" around here, then...
Teehee, that word always fills Paimon with excitement!
When are those two foreign guests going to realize that this whole thing is a scam...
*sigh*... It's happened so many times... *sigh* This hustler Mamull keeps using me to scam people...
But my child is locked up in there. If I could just stage a rescue...
The door has been opened...
Really... When was that? Huh, was it when those two foreigners approached a while back...?
Right. I know what to do. Hmph, that lying liar who lies shall receive well-deserved punishment!
Hmph, just keep playing that game. That sneaky swindler is going to taste utter defeat this time!
I'm done!
Okay, let's see about your results, shall we?
What a shame, dear guests, you almost got it...
Wait, that can't be! Our answer was correct, Paimon's sure of it!
Ah, well, doesn't everyone who gets it wrong think so too? That's normal, absolutely normal. The final test's difficulty is different from the others, though...
"This is the final test, sure, but it looks easy enough..."
Ask yourself this, my little flying guest: Did you not think this way, even if but once?
Uh... Maybe...?
And there's the rub! This is a hero's trial, mind you — there's no way I could let you breeze past it that easily.
But that's fine. I'll let you try again for free!
That way, you'll witness the final trial's true difficulty for yourself!
Really? No need for any Mora this time around?
S—Seeing as it's free, let's give it another go...
"Free"'s the highest price of them all...
That doesn't make sense either, but anyway... let's give this one more try!
So then, your second try of the final trial. Shall we begin?
Let's do this.
Hehe. Well then, do be careful this time.
Seeing as it's free...
That's right! This try's free anyway!
How about it? Would you like to try the Painted Stone Challenge? Or would you like to learn more about the rules again?
When are those two foreign guests going to realize that this whole thing is a scam...
*sigh*... It's happened so many times... *sigh* This hustler Mamull keeps using me to scam people...
But my child is locked up in there. If I could just stage a rescue...
Be careful... This fellow's a cunning one... *sigh*
Ohh... When can I get out of here...
Dammit, you bloody Iktomisaur, you... Don't you care about your own child anymore?
Krraaa—!
Hmph! We realized something was up, and we've already saved the little Iktomisaurus!
So this trial's a scam...
And here I thought that we had two fattened outlander sheep waltzing in, but no, you're just scoundrels, here to ruin everything!
Krraaa—!
Alright, alright! I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
Give our Mora back!
Yeah, it was 500 Mora each time... and you scammed Paimon so many times!
Alright, alright! Here, you two... take it. This... This should be enough, right?
Krraaa—!
Uh... Mister... or Miss... Saurian...? L—Let's talk this through, shall we?
Look, I provided your child with a safe place, gave it food and water... Aren't you going to show even a little gratitude?
Mouthing off at a time like this, huh?
Rawr!
N—No, pl—please!

The Iktomisaurus flaps its wings, sending frigid air swirling around the scammer who had trapped its child.\nSoon, the swindler Mamull is forced to flee under the threat of razor-sharp Saurian claws...
After that, the Iktomisaurus bows in thanks before departing, youngling in tow.
Hmph, this guy kept scamming Paimon for all that Mora, over and over again!
Serves him right!
I haven't finished coloring yet.
Of course, but the longer you spend doing this, the more the color will seep out of your memory...
Let's do this.
Wonderful! Ah, such excitement! Come then, traveler from afar, dear esteemed guest: Can you pass the test this time around? This way, please...!
Now then, as for the stones mentioned in the quiz before... What color were they?
Well, are you ready with Round 1's answers?
My, how quick-witted you are, dear guest! This test is too easy, too basic for you.
But as you can see, there's still a little bit to go before your final reward.
How about it? Do you want to keep going? In any case... Hehe, it's 500 Mora to play.
Let's keep going. We've got more than enough to cover the fee...
Thank you for your patronage, then!
Alright, alright. Now then, Round Two of the Painted Stone Challenge — a tougher challenge, to be sure. What will the result be? Would you like to begin?
Go on then, shall we try Round 2 of the Painted Stone Challenge? Or would you like to hear about the rules again?
Oh-ho, there were more stones, I imagine? Now, what color were they?
Well then! Are your Round 2 answers ready?
You had to memorize the color of the extra stone, but you guessed them all correctly without hesitation! You might be from a foreign land, but you really are an incredible hero.
And now, we've reached this stage at last... If you can answer this final question and clear the final stage— I mean, the final trial, and the reward will be yours!
How about it? Would you like to keep going?
Here's 500 Mora...
And indeed it is. Thanks for your patronage!
Round 3 of the Painted Stone Challenge, my foreign guest, is the final test, and a tremendously exciting one at that! Shall we begin now?
Go on then, shall we try Round 3 of the Painted Stone Challenge? Or would you like to hear about the rules again?
Haha! So, the final trial. Sometimes, the most dangerous moment comes precisely when you're closest to victory...
Well, are you ready for the final round?
Give me some time to prepare...
No worries. Just tell me once you're done.

It's done!

Ah, what a terrible shame, isn't it — to feel as if you've gotten it instantly, but somehow fail at the end, no matter what you do.
But this is also part of a hero's trial. Go on then, dear foreign guest: Would you like to continue the challenge...?
That said, it is 500 Mora a pop. Don't forget about that.
